audit.meaning: Audit acceptance does not convert reference mismatches into published-output agreement.

control.method: Solve the unmodified original native source FEMM model independently of the source-reconstruction compiler; use a locally authored postprocessor script. No downloaded script was executed.
control.input_and_retained_file_note: source_model_sha256 identifies the downloaded passive input bytes before FEMM opened them. The retained original.fem was reserialized by native FEMM during the control; its separate hash identifies that post-run file.

reference_discrepancy.causal_status: Unresolved. Original-source and reconstructed models agree on the current native engine, but both differ from the article energy and inductance. Possible engine, meshing, or source-model/version differences need further study; the evidence does not establish which cause is responsible.
reference_discrepancy.presentation: Individual EI reports retain failed published inductance and energy checks. A green audit means native checks and the reviewed original-source regression passed, not that every paper target passed.

original_source_regression_checks.meaning: Regression comparison only; published reference remains failed.
Regression comparison only; published reference remains failed.
